verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's built-in Copilot answers analyst-style questions about your data by generating a report or dashboard, which is a direct in-product, AI-driven insight capability. The evidence covers only on-demand report and dashboard generation. Nothing shows proactive suggestions or narrative insights, such as next-best actions or AI flags on at-risk deals. Missing for 10: proactive AI suggestions or recommendations, explicit AI-written insight summaries beyond reports and dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask what you would ask a sales analyst and get a report or a dashboard back.
Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests
